blocks.tamil_translation: called the tree that was at the edge of the valley to come, and the tree, splitting the earth, came and stood before the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ told it to bear witness (say the Kalimah of Shahadah) three times; it bore witness (said the Kalimah of Shahadah) three times just as Rasulullah ﷺ had said, and then went back to its place. (The villager who had been watching all of this was astonished.) He said to Rasulullah ﷺ, “If my people accept what I say, I will bring all of them with me to you; otherwise, I myself will come back to you and stay with you,” and then he went back to his people.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ: انْفُذْ عَلَي رِسْلِكَ، حَتَّي تَنْزِلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ، ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَي اْلإِسْلَامِ، وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ بِمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ حَقِّ اللهِ فِيهِ، فَوَاللهِ! لأَنْ يَهْدِيَ اللهُ بِكَ رَجُلاً وَاحِدًا خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَكَ حُمُرُ النَّعَمِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو جزء من الحديث) رواه مسلم، باب من فضائل علي بن ابي طالب ﵁ رقم:٦٢٢٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sahl ibn Sa'd (RA) narrates, “At the battle of Khaibar, Rasulullah ﷺ said to Hazrat Ali (RA), “Set out calmly. Camp in the open ground of the people of Khaibar, then invite them to Islam, and tell them the duties they owe to Allah Ta'ala. By Allah Ta'ala! That Allah Ta'ala guides even one person to the right path through you is better for you than having red camels.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- Among the Arabs, red camels were considered highly valuable.
